items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I know Norman was lookin' for Louie Bellson to record somethin' with Basie not long ago

ctx.x: Is that the session that Jake Hanna was the drummer? 'Cause I know Norman was lookin' for Louie Bellson to record somethin' with Basie not long ago, and Louie was out of town...
I don't know who it was.
